tree.md:
List contents of directories in a tree-like format.

## Synopsis

tree \[OPTION]... \[DIRECTORY]...

## Description

Recursively lists the contents of DIRECTORY (default: current directory) as an indented tree.

## Options

-a Include hidden files.

-d List directories only.

-L LEVEL Limit depth of directory tree.

-f Print full path prefix for each file.

\--help Display help and exit.

## Examples

$ tree

Show the tree for the current directory.

$ tree -L 2 /workspace

Show two levels of depth under /workspace.

$ tree -d

Show directories only.

## Notes

Operates on the SLICC virtual filesystem.

## See Also

[ls](https://main--slicc-website--ai-ecoverse.aem.live/man/ls), [find](https://main--slicc-website--ai-ecoverse.aem.live/man/find), [du](https://main--slicc-website--ai-ecoverse.aem.live/man/du)

man.md:
Fetch documentation for a given topic.

## Synopsis

man \<topic>

## Description

Fetches documentation for a given topic from sliccy.com, the same set of pages this site publishes under /man/.

## Examples

$ man ls

Show the man page for ls.

$ man grep

Show the man page for grep.

## Notes

Fetches over the network; requires connectivity to sliccy.com. This is the mechanism behind the /man/ pages on this site.

## See Also

[help](https://main--slicc-website--ai-ecoverse.aem.live/man/help), [commands](https://main--slicc-website--ai-ecoverse.aem.live/man/commands)
